title: Ruud Furnace Code 10: Ignition Lockout
meaning: The furnace stopped trying to ignite after multiple failed attempts.
whenToCallPro: Ignition lockouts usually need ignitor or sensor service.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 10 means furnace stopped trying to ignite after multiple failed attempts. Most often from failed ignitor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$450.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 11: Ignition Failure
meaning: Flame was not established during the ignition sequence.
whenToCallPro: Persistent ignition failure requires professional diagnosis.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 11 means Flame was not established during the ignition sequence. Most often from worn ignitor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$450.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 12: Flame Rollout
meaning: The rollout switch opened due to abnormal heat at the burner.
whenToCallPro: Rollout trips indicate a serious combustion issue.
dangerNote: If you smell gas or see soot, leave the area and call a technician.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 12 means rollout switch opened due to abnormal heat at the burner. This is an emergency — do not attempt DIY repairs. Call a licensed technician immediately; typical repairs run $500–$3500.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 13: Limit Switch Open
meaning: The limit switch opened because the furnace overheated.
whenToCallPro: Repeated limit trips need blower or limit switch service.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 13 means limit switch opened because the furnace overheated. Most often from dirty filter. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$600.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 14: Igniter Fault
meaning: The igniter circuit failed a resistance or timing check.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 14 means igniter circuit failed a resistance or timing check. Most often from cracked ignitor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$450.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 21: Pressure Switch Stuck Open
meaning: The pressure switch never closed during inducer operation.
whenToCallPro: Replace failed pressure switch or inducer.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 21 means pressure switch never closed during inducer operation. Most often from blocked vent. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $175–$900.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 22: Pressure Switch Stuck Closed
meaning: The pressure switch stayed closed when the inducer was off.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 22 means pressure switch stayed closed when the inducer was off. Most often from water in pressure line. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $175–$550.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 31: Gas Valve Fault
meaning: The control detected a gas valve circuit error.
whenToCallPro: Gas valve faults require licensed repair.
dangerNote: If you smell gas, leave the house and call your gas utility before anything else.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 31 means control detected a gas valve circuit error. This is an emergency — do not attempt DIY repairs. Call a licensed technician immediately; typical repairs run $350–$900.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 33: Flame Sensor Fault
meaning: The flame sensor did not prove flame after ignition.
whenToCallPro: Replace the sensor if cleaning fails.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 33 means flame sensor did not prove flame after ignition. Most often from dirty sensor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$300.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 41: Blower Motor Fault
meaning: The blower motor failed to start or tripped on overcurrent.
whenToCallPro: Blower motor or capacitor replacement is usually needed.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 41 means blower motor failed to start or tripped on overcurrent. Most often from failed motor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $450–$1200.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 42: Inducer Motor Fault
meaning: The inducer motor did not operate during venting.
whenToCallPro: Inducer motor replacement if it will not start.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 42 means inducer motor did not operate during venting. Most often from seized inducer. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $400–$900.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 43: Control Board Fault
meaning: The control board reported an internal error.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 43 means control board reported an internal error. Most often from surge damage. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $300–$800.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 44: Low Flame Signal
meaning: Flame current dropped below the minimum during operation.
whenToCallPro: Low flame signals need gas and venting checks.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 44 means Flame current dropped below the minimum during operation. Most often from dirty sensor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$400.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 45: Rollout Switch Open
meaning: The rollout switch tripped during burner operation.
dangerNote: If you smell gas, leave the area and call a technician.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 45 means rollout switch tripped during burner operation. This is an emergency — do not attempt DIY repairs. Call a licensed technician immediately; typical repairs run $500–$3500.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 51: Thermostat Communication Error
meaning: The board lost communication with a smart thermostat.
whenToCallPro: May need thermostat or board replacement.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 51 means board lost communication with a smart thermostat. Most often from incompatible stat. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$400.

title: Ruud Furnace Code 61: Condensate Overflow
meaning: The condensate safety switch detected a drainage problem.
whenToCallPro: If drainage is clear, replace the switch or pump.
snippetAnswer: Ruud furnace code 61 means condensate safety switch detected a drainage problem. Often caused by clogged trap. Usually safe to try basic checks yourself; professional repairs run $150–$450.
